issues.title: Ingest Saline County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $74,159,348 across 53 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($25,778,327), County Road Fund ($14,283,057), Sales and Use Bond Construction Fund ($6,588,014). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
